verdict.rationale: Bento is an LLM/agent observability and improvement platform, so a prompt playground is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents a playground for running prompts against real models with variables. Prompt versioning and diffing (docs-15) and editing a signal's prompt via the CLI (docs-36) are adjacent features, not interactive prompt iteration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
